verdicts.reason: A moves the Monograph logo to the bottom-left corner as a tiny afterthought with an illegible 'Gallery' line. That breaks the brand-first reading order and leaves it off the centre axis everything else uses. It also puts the price above the product name and leaves the narrow centre column floating in wide empty sides. B keeps the logo at the top on the centre axis, so the order is brand, product, then CTA. But B's logo is undersized and its 'Gallery' is unreadable, and it shares A's flaws: price above the name and a thin column that ignores the square format, with large dead side areas.
